# r/washingtonwizards (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Washington Wizards stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Washington Wizards in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #47 Anthony Davis 57.9
- #76 Trae Young 54.4
- #88 AJ Dybantsa 53.4 (rookie)
- #133 Alex Sarr 48.5
- #178 Justin Champagnie 45.4
- #191 Deandre Ayton 44.8
- #209 Kyshawn George 43.2
- #240 Bilal Coulibaly 41.6

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
